output.reason: I find this convincing because it uses the eight robots still on old firmware in the same lanes as a natural control, and a bench test backs it up. Together these rule out the temps and explain both the vendor's clean record at other sites and why the shiny wrap caused nothing in August. The bench test is small, though, and the brief doesn't settle what to do about the 6.3 security deadline.
